data_description.dataset_name: MODIS Land Cover Type Yearly Global 500m (MCD12Q1 V061)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land surface coverage at 500m resolution providing annual land cover classifications from 2001 to 2024.

data_description.records: ImageCollection with yearly global land cover from 2001-2024

LC_Type1.description: IGBP (International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme) classification with 17 classes

LC_Type2.description: University of Maryland (UMD) classification with 15 classes

LC_Type3.description: LAI (Leaf Area Index) based classification with 10 classes

LC_Type5.description: Plant Functional Types classification with 11 classes

raster_content.thematic_group: Global Land Use and Land Cover

band_semantics.LC_Type1: Primary IGBP land cover classification used for most applications

data_description.important_note: MCD12Q1 provides multiple classification schemes (IGBP, UMD, LAI, BGC, PFT) allowing flexibility in analysis. The 23-year time series enables robust land cover change detection and trend analysis.
analytical_capabilities: Multi-classification scheme comparison (IGBP, UMD, LAI, BGC, PFT)
Biome shift detection over two decades

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Categorical land cover type codes specific to each classification scheme.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Select LC_Type1 (IGBP) for standard land cover analysis; use temporal filtering to compare across years.

data_description.data_source: NASA LP DAAC at the USGS EROS Center via Google Earth Engine
